titleEn: How Much Does a Renovation Cost in Vancouver and BC? A Complete Budget Planning Guide (2026)
titleZh: 温哥华及BC省装修费用指南（2026年）：完整预算规划
contentEn:
Most Vancouver homeowners who call us for a quote ask one question first: "How much will it cost?" The honest answer is that renovation budgets in BC in 2026 can range from $15,000 for a single bathroom update to over $500,000 for a whole-house transformation. This guide breaks down what drives those numbers — based on real project costs from 聚星装修 (Reno Stars) and publicly available permit and labour data for Metro Vancouver.

What Does a Kitchen Renovation Cost in Vancouver (2026)?

A cosmetic kitchen refresh — new cabinet fronts, updated lighting, fresh paint — typically runs $15,000 to $35,000 in Vancouver. A full gut renovation with new cabinets, quartz countertops, appliances, and reconfigured plumbing starts around $45,000 and can exceed $130,000 for large or high-spec kitchens.

Kitchen Renovation Type2026 Vancouver Range
Cosmetic refresh$15,000 – $35,000
Standard full gut$45,000 – $85,000
Large or high-spec$85,000 – $130,000+

Labour accounts for roughly 40–60% of a kitchen renovation budget in Metro Vancouver, with the remainder going to materials and finishes. Cabinetry alone can consume 25–35% of the total.

Planning a kitchen renovation in Vancouver? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars tailored to your layout and budget.

What Does a Bathroom Renovation Cost in Vancouver (2026)?

A mid-range bathroom renovation in Vancouver — new vanity, walk-in shower, tile, toilet, and basic plumbing updates — typically costs $18,000 to $38,000. High-end master bath renovations with heated floors, freestanding tubs, and custom glass can reach $60,000 to $90,000.

Bathroom Renovation Type2026 Vancouver Range
Standard update$12,000 – $25,000
Mid-range full reno$18,000 – $38,000
High-end master bath$40,000 – $90,000

Plumbing modification costs in BC are regulated by a licensed plumber; budget $1,500–$4,000 for moving drain or water lines, which is a common request in bathroom redesigns.

What Does a Whole-House Renovation Cost in Vancouver (2026)?

Whole-house renovations in Metro Vancouver typically start at $150 per square foot for a basic renovation and climb to $350–$600+ per square foot for a full structural renovation with heritage preservation requirements. A 2,000 sq ft home renovation can therefore range from $300,000 to over $1,200,000 depending on scope.

Whole-House Reno Scope2026 Vancouver Cost/Sq Ft
Basic renovation$150 – $200/sq ft
Mid-range renovation$200 – $350/sq ft
High-end / heritage$350 – $600+/sq ft

Real example: a Richmond homeowner completed a whole-house renovation including a new kitchen, two updated bathrooms, new flooring throughout, and a partial basement finish for $285,000 (1,900 sq ft). Permit and engineering fees added approximately $8,200.

What Drives Renovation Costs in Vancouver Beyond the Obvious?

Three cost factors surprise homeowners most. First, pre-1980 homes in Vancouver often contain asbestos in floor tiles, wall textures, and pipe insulation — testing and remediation adds $2,000 to $15,000 depending on home size and scope. Second, knob-and-tube wiring, common in homes built before 1950, must be fully replaced before walls are closed; budget $8,000–$20,000 for a typical Vancouver bungalow. Third, Vancouver's zoning and building bylaw reviews add permit fees of 1–3% of the construction value and engineering review fees of $3,000–$12,000 on larger projects.

BC Homeowner Protection Act requires all residential construction work valued at $20,000 or more to be overseen by a licensed residential builder and include third-party home warranty coverage. Budget 2–3% of the construction value for this requirement.

How to Budget for Your Vancouver Renovation: A Realistic Checklist

Experienced contractors in Vancouver typically structure a renovation budget as follows:

  • Construction hard costs: 70–80% of total
  • Design and architectural fees: 5–10%
  • Permits and engineering: 3–5%
  • Contingency fund: 10–20% of hard costs (never less than 10%)
  • Living expenses during reno (if displaced): 3–5%

The most common budget overrun in Vancouver renovations is the 15–20% contingency being consumed by hidden structural or code-compliance issues discovered after walls are opened. Always fund the contingency before signing a contract.

Financing Options for Vancouver Homeowners (2026)

Renovation financing options available to BC homeowners include Home Equity Lines of Credit (HELOCs) at prime plus 0.5–1%, BC Hydro's efficiency upgrade financing program, and CMHC's Affordability Fund for qualifying households. BC's Property Transfer Tax does not apply to renovation loans, but lender appraisal and setup fees for a HELOC typically total $500–$1,500.

How Long Does a Renovation Take in Vancouver (2026)?

Permit timelines in Vancouver vary significantly by project type and city. Surrey and Richmond typically process building permits in 4–8 weeks for standard residential renovations; Vancouver and West Vancouver can take 8–15 weeks for the same scope. A mid-range kitchen renovation in Vancouver typically takes 8–14 weeks from demolition to final inspection; a whole-house renovation typically runs 6–12 months.

Reno Stars has completed 60 renovation projects across Metro Vancouver since 2026, including kitchen renovations, whole-house transformations, and multi-bathroom upgrades.

How much does a kitchen renovation cost in Vancouver in 2026?

A cosmetic kitchen refresh costs $15,000–$35,000; a full gut renovation starts at $45,000 and can exceed $130,000 for large or high-spec kitchens in Vancouver.

What is the average cost per square foot for a whole-house renovation in Vancouver?

In 2026, a whole-house renovation in Vancouver ranges $150–$350 per square foot depending on scope. High-end or heritage renovations can reach $600+/square foot.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Vancouver?

Any bathroom renovation that moves plumbing or electrical requires a permit in Vancouver. Cosmetic updates like painting, new fixtures, and flooring without structural changes typically do not require a permit.

How much should I budget for contingency in a Vancouver renovation?

Plan a minimum 10% contingency fund on top of your hard construction costs — 15–20% is recommended for older homes where hidden issues are more likely.

Yes. Contact Reno Stars for a free, no-obligation renovation quote in Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Surrey, Coquitlam, or any Metro Vancouver city.
contentZh:
大多数致电聚星装修的温哥华业主，第一个问题就是：「装修要花多少钱？」事实上，2026年BC省的装修预算可以从单间浴室更新的15,000加元到整屋翻新的超过500,000加元不等。本文基于聚星装修的真实项目数据及公开的许可证和人工成本信息，详细解析各项费用的构成。

2026年温哥华厨房装修费用是多少？

温哥华的轻度厨房翻新——更换橱柜表面、更新照明、粉刷油漆——通常费用在15,000至35,000加元之间。而全面拆旧重装的厨房，包括新橱柜、石英石台面、新家电以及管线调整，起价约为45,000加元，大型或高端规格厨房更可超过130,000加元。

厨房装修类型2026年温哥华价格区间
轻度翻新$15,000 – $35,000
标准全拆重装$45,000 – $85,000
大型或高端规格$85,000 – $130,000+

在温哥华地区，人工费用约占厨房装修预算的40%至60%，其余部分用于材料和饰面。橱柜一项即可占总费用的25%至35%。

2026年温哥华浴室装修费用是多少？

温哥华的中档浴室装修——新洗手台、独立淋浴间、瓷砖、更换马桶及基础管线更新——通常费用在18,000至38,000加元之间。配备地暖、独立浴缸和定制玻璃的高端主卧浴室，费用可高达60,000至90,000加元。

浴室装修类型2026年温哥华价格区间
标准更新$12,000 – $25,000
中档全翻新$18,000 – $38,000
高端主卧浴室$40,000 – $90,000

BC省的管线修改工程必须由持牌水管工进行；移动排水管或供水管的费用约为1,500至4,000加元，这是浴室改造中常见的需求。

2026年温哥华整屋装修费用是多少？

大温哥华地区的整屋装修，通常从每平方英尺150加元的基础翻新，到每平方英尺350至600加元以上的高端翻新不等。因此，一套2,000平方英尺房屋的装修费用可从300,000加元到超过1,200,000加元，视具体范围而定。

整屋装修范围2026年温哥华每平方英尺单价
基础翻新$150 – $200/平方英尺
中档翻新$200 – $350/平方英尺
高端/文物保护$350 – $600+/平方英尺

真实案例：列治文一位业主完成了包含新厨房、两间翻新浴室、全屋地板及部分地下室装修的整屋翻新项目，费用为285,000加元（1,900平方英尺）。许可证及工程审核费用额外增加约8,200加元。

温哥华装修中哪些隐性因素会影响预算？

有三个成本因素最让业主意外。第一，温哥华1980年以前的房屋通常含有石棉（位于地板砖、墙体涂料和管道保温层中），检测和处理费用约为2,000至15,000加元，视房屋面积和工程范围而定。第二，1950年以前建造房屋中常见的knob-and-tube布线（铁管布线系统），必须在墙体封闭前全面更换；一套典型温哥华平房的此项费用约为8,000至20,000加元。第三，温哥华的区划和建筑条例审查会增加许可证费用，约为建筑造价的1至3%，大型项目还需工程审核费3,000至12,000加元。

BC省《业主保护法》要求，造价20,000加元及以上的所有住宅建筑工程必须由持牌住宅建筑商监督，并包含第三方房屋保修计划。在预算中需另计工程造价的2至3%用于此合规要求。

如何为温哥华装修制定合理预算：实用清单

温哥华有经验的承包商通常按以下比例分配装修预算：

  • 建筑硬成本：占总额的70至80%
  • 设计和建筑费用：5至10%
  • 许可证及工程费用：3至5%
  • 应急备用金：硬成本的10至20%（最低不少于10%）
  • 装修期间居住费用（若需迁出）：3至5%

温哥华装修中最常见的预算超支，是15至20%的应急备用金被墙体打开后发现的隐蔽结构或合规问题所消耗。在签署合同前，务必确保应急备用金已到位。

温哥华业主的装修融资选择（2026年）

BC省业主可用的装修融资渠道包括：房屋净值信用额度（HELOC，利率为最优惠利率加0.5至1%）、BC水电局的节能升级融资计划，以及CMHC针对合资格家庭的负担能力基金。BC省的房产转让税不适用于装修贷款，但HELOC的评估和设置费用通常为500至1,500加元。

2026年温哥华装修需要多长时间？

温哥华的许可证审批时间因项目类型和城市而异。素里和列治文通常在4至8周内完成普通住宅装修的建筑许可证审批；温哥华和西温哥华的同等规模项目可能需要8至15周。温哥华中档厨房装修从拆除到最终验收通常需要8至14周；整屋装修通常需要6至12个月。

聚星装修自2026年以来，已在大温哥华地区完成60个装修项目，涵盖厨房翻新、全屋改造及多间浴室升级。

2026年温哥华厨房装修一般需要多少钱？

轻度厨房翻新费用为15,000至35,000加元；全面拆旧重装起价45,000加元，大型或高端规格厨房更可超过130,000加元。

温哥华整屋装修每平方英尺的平均成本是多少？

2026年，温哥华整屋装修的费用约为每平方英尺150至350加元，视装修范围而定。高端或文物保护类装修可达每平方英尺600加元以上。

温哥华浴室装修需要申请许可证吗？

温哥华任何涉及管线或电气改动的浴室装修均需申请许可证。仅涉及油漆、新固定装置以及无结构改动的地板更换等轻度翻新，通常无需申请许可证。

温哥华装修应该预留多少应急备用金？

建议在硬装修成本的基础上预留至少10%的应急备用金；对于房龄较长的房屋，建议预留15至20%，因为发现隐蔽问题的可能性更高。

聚星装修提供免费报价吗？

是的。请联系聚星装修，获取温哥华、列治文、本拿比、素里、高贵林及大温哥华其他城市的免费、无义务装修报价。
